newsitem.title: USA: MassMutual says it names Joseph Zubretsky as CFO.
newsitem.headline: MassMutual says it names Joseph Zubretsky as CFO.

text.p: Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance co said on Tuesday that it named Joseph Zubretsky executive vice president and chief financial officer.

A former partner with Coopers & Lybrand, Zubretsky worked with MassMutual on a number of recent major initiatives, including the sale of the company's life and health benefits management subsidiary and the MassMutual/Connecticut Mutual merger, the company said in a statement.
Zubretsky comes to MassMutual after a year as chief financial officer for Healthsource Inc, a managed health care company sold to CIGNA Corp.

In a separate statement, MassMutual said it has named Daniel Fitzgerald president and chief executive officer of MassMutual International. He had previously fulfilled Zubretsky's role at the company, heading financial operations as executive vice president.
MassMutual International was formed in February 1996 to develop worldwide life insurance operations in expanding and developing foreign markets, the company said.
